about: DRAFT, never run. LFM2.5-24B-A2B (lfm2moe: 30 gated short-convolution blocks + 10 GQA blocks, 64 experts top-4, 2.45B active) at Q8_0 from Liquid AI's GGUF repository, text only, on the RTX Spark N1X's GPU at its native 131,072 tokens. Upstream llama.cpp b11718 (lfm2moe in llama-arch.cpp; common/chat.cpp has the LFM2.5 template handler for its Pythonic tool calls). It always thinks (the template opens <think>), so --reasoning-format deepseek. Liquid AI's sampling (temperature 0.1, top-k 50, repetition penalty 1.05; the GGUF also carries them). No draft: the LFM2.5-24B-A2B DSpark draft is 'coming soon', for SGLang. 10 attention layers x 8 KV heads x 64: 131,072 tokens is 2.5 GiB f16.
setup: One RTX Spark N1X. 25.5 GB of downloads (one Q8_0 GGUF). Expected resident memory ~27 GiB at 131,072 tokens (23.7 GiB weights, 2.5 GiB f16 KV, compute buffers). Licence: LFM Open License v1.0 (Hub 'other'): Apache-style, but commercial use is licensed only below US$10M annual revenue.
